Bill.BriefDescription: Including the boards of trustees of technical colleges in the definition of "executive state officer."

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to executive state officers; and amending RCW42.17.2401.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.2401 and 2006 c 265 s 113 are each amended toread as follows:
